mission: Move every admissible part of RDE-X1 physical execution from one-man operation to one-machine orchestration while preserving real-hardware provenance and frozen acceptance criteria.

parallel_independent.name: FAE — Visual Language, Art Direction & Rebrand

architecture.browser_harness: One frozen browser harness executes the canonical PoW semantics, full-duration RDE workloads, normal-use scripted latency measurement, lifecycle recording and capture export.
architecture.local_agent: Optional zero-dependency Node.js controller detects device/OS, serves the harness on localhost, records telemetry where available, receives captures, packages evidence and invokes the existing deterministic verifier.
architecture.online_harness: Vercel preview serves the same browser harness for devices where installing/running the local agent is undesirable, especially iPad Safari.
architecture.evidence_boundary: The autopilot may prepare and execute real physical runs only on a real device actually running the harness. Rehearsal mode is permanently labeled REHEARSAL_ONLY.

device_strategy.mobile_tablet_arm: online Safari harness; exact model is locked before first measurement; lifecycle transitions require actual background/foreground events.
device_strategy.thin_light_integrated: local agent preferred; browser-only online path remains valid fallback.
device_strategy.consumer_discrete_gpu: local agent preferred for GPU identity/thermal telemetry; workload remains the frozen browser PoW implementation rather than CUDA-specific mining.
device_strategy.compact_handheld_consumer: local agent or browser-only path; lifecycle transitions remain required.

autonomous_after_bootstrap: event-loop interaction baseline and p95 derivation
irreducible_physical_or_external: turning on or physically connecting a device when no remote control exists
opening the online harness on iPad if no remote browser-control channel exists
five real iPad background/foreground transitions required by lifecycle evidence
reading a non-digital wall wattmeter unless the operator supplies readings or a machine-readable meter is attached
providing an unavailable required device class

may_autonomously: deploy preview-only online harness through existing Vercel Git integration
package physical evidence that a real device actually produces
advance every software-only frontier without asking proceed
may_not: simulate background/foreground and label it physical
select devices after observing their FAE result
